Create a high-fidelity UI DESIGN MOCKUP, one COMPLETE desktop web application screen, VAHAN Analyst vehicle registration analytics. Full-bleed app screen 1536x1024 landscape, no exterior padding or caption board, no browser/device frame, NO mobile inset. Actual carefully art-directed product design, refined enterprise typography, aligned baseline grid, enough space to breathe without wasting screen, crisp readable labels, polished restrained color. Do not use a tiny text dense infographic. No generic revenue/orders/customers or fictional counts. No gradients, glass, glows, 3D, clipart, decorative car logos, oversized icons, extra badges, stacked cards inside cards or repetitive thin-outline panel soup.

DESIGN SYSTEM: modern humanist sans like Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Segoe UI for controls, 32px page heading, 52–60px primary metric, 24px secondary metrics, 16px body, 14px controls/tables, 12px metadata. Warm white #F7F8FA canvas, white surfaces, ink #182139, secondary text #586174, action indigo #4F46B8, soft lavender #EFEDF9; supporting apricot #F6BEA5 with dark ink. Fuel colors Petrol slate blue #535E8D; ELECTRIC(BOV) deep teal #137C73; PURE EV violet #7258AC; PETROL(E20) burnt orange #AD602F; CNG #2F718C; ethanol gray. Use thin dividers instead of enclosing every element. 8px control radius, 12px only major surfaces. 24px group spacing, 32px sections,44px action hit areas. White text only on dark buttons.

DESIGN DISCIPLINE researched before composing: UI/UX Pro Max progressive disclosure, hierarchy by scale/space not equal cards, logical navigation, tabular figures, exact labels, chart matched to task. Animate UI inspires one restrained active-state indicator and an expandable filter sheet; React Bits inspires brief result reveal NOT rolling/count-up figures; Inspira UI inspires asymmetric spans NOT magic effects. Native scrolling; no Lenis. These are invisible design reasoning, NEVER write library names or implementation notes in the actual dashboard.

REFERENCES reinterpreted: Habib Skillify grouped work areas and selected activity; InfoGraphix strong metric-to-chart scales without its shiny gradients; ACERO warm quiet surfaces, peach accents and confident whitespace without its promo calendar; finance photo3 disciplined tables and chart hierarchy. Give VAHAN its own coherent identity.
